basic_info.description: Style, functionality & elegance abound in this beautifully renovated Top floor 2BR/2BA CONDO with an additional OFFICE and a light-filled SUNROOM. Classic features incl. hardwood floors, a wood burning fireplace, moldings and high ceilings create an appealing aesthetic throughout. A large living room offering some downtown views is connected to the dining room via pocket doors. The renovated kitchen has plentiful cabinetry and counter space. The sleek guest bath features a luxurious tub, rich tile work, a skylight and modern flair. At the rear of the home are two large south facing bedrooms, including a large primary suite w/new bathroom and a versatile sunroom. One bedroom has a small patio and spiral staircase to the large,lush shared yard. Additional conveniences include an in-unit washer/dryer, Nest thermostat, recessed lighting, 1-car parking and an additional storage room. Short stroll to the chic shops and restaurants on Divisadero Street: Souvla, The Mill, Che Fico, BiRite market. Target, Trader Joe's, Kaiser Hospital, USF and GGPark Panhandle are also within walking distance.
